title: Ni–Fe bimetallic carbon nanotube catalysts derived from a two-dimensional metalloporphyrin Fe-MOF precursor for oxygen reduction and oxygen evolution reactions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15490-15503
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01624C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yunyang Wu
NiFe@CNT, a MOF-derived bifunctional electrocatalytic material, was successfully synthesized by pyrolysis and applied in ORR and OER. In alkaline electrolyte, the ORR proceeds predominantly through a four-electron pathway converting O2 to H2O.
